name: Apartment
description: A small home with walls between every room and no open spaces.
rules: An event in one room only changes accessories in that same room.
When motion is detected in a room and the house is awake, turn on the main overhead light in that room at standard.
When motion is detected in a room and the house is asleep, change nothing.
Motion never changes a light that is already on.
When the wall button is pressed in a room where all lights are off, turn on the main overhead light in that room at standard.
When the wall button is pressed in a room where at least one light is on, turn off every light in that room.
On a motion timeout, turn off the lights in that room that were turned on by motion. Lights that were turned on by the button stay as they are.
When the house goes to sleep, turn off every light in every room.
When the house wakes up, when everyone leaves, or when someone arrives home, change nothing.
